reason: The README describes a CLI distribution and extension layer for installing, trimming, customizing, and activating DeepSeek Harness plugins and capability packs.

summaries.zh: 一个用于在本地通过命令行安装、配置和扩展 DeepSeek Harness 运行时及其插件的轻量工具包。
summaries.en: A lightweight command-line toolkit for installing, configuring, and extending a local DeepSeek Harness runtime with selected plugins and capability packs.

capabilities: Installs and validates a local DeepSeek Harness runtime profile
Activates selected capability packs and plugins
Runs one model task through a command-line interface
Uses configured external model API endpoints
May enable optional shell and network capabilities through packs
